target.statement: Stacked Ensemble model achieves 90% accuracy on binary NSL-KDD classification

compute.basis: NSL-KDD is small (~148k rows, 41 features); MLJAR AutoML with default settings on 8 CPU cores should finish in under 30 minutes, and the paper's reported GPU use is not necessary for this dataset.

blockers: No official code or configuration for the paper's specific MLJAR setup is provided; only the general MLJAR library is linked.
Exact hyperparameters and ensemble weights are not fully specified, so reproducing the exact 90% accuracy may require trial and error.
title: An AutoML-based approach for Network Intrusion Detection
